items.title: Armed Resupply Pods
items.description: Mounts a modified AR-23 Liberator to all resupply pods, allowing them to double as automatic turrets.

items.title: Concealed Insertion
items.description: Equips Hellpods to deploy smokescreens on impact, obscuring Helldiver deployment.

items.title: Dead Sprint
items.description: Allows Helldivers to keep sprinting even when they are out of stamina, draining their health instead.

items.title: Experimental Infusion
items.description: In addition to restoring health, stims temporarily increase movement speed and damage reduction.

items.title: Expert Extraction Pilot
items.description: Lowers the time it takes for the extraction shuttle to reach the extraction beacon.

items.title: Firebomb Hellpods
items.description: Lines all Hellpods with volatile incendiaries that detonate upon impact, igniting any units in vicinity of the drop site.

items.title: Flexible Reinforcement Budget
items.description: Reduce time until new reinforcements are granted once they've been depleted.

items.title: Hellpod Space Optimization
items.description: Helldivers come out of the Hellpod fully stocked on Ammo, Grenades, and Stims.

items.title: Increased Reinforcement Budget
items.description: Increases the number of available reinforcements.

items.title: Integrated Extinguishers
items.description: Equips Helldiver uniforms with form-fitting, automated, rapid-response fire suppression systems. Significantly reduces the time it takes to naturally extinguish flames without conducting ground-aided smothering manuevers.

items.title: Localization Confusion
items.description: Increases the time between enemy encounters.

items.title: Motivational Shocks
items.description: Allows all Helldivers to recover faster after being slowed by an attack, such as acid. Does not mitigate “area effects,” such as EMS strikes.

items.title: Muscle Enhancement
items.description: Allows Helldivers to traverse difficult terrain with ease.

items.title: Sample Extricator
items.description: Large enemies now have a chance of dropping Samples on death. Capped at 10 drops per mission.

items.title: Sample Scanner
items.description: The Sample scanner gives you a 15% chance to receive twice the Samples on sample pick up.

items.title: Stamina Enhancement
items.description: Increases all Helldivers' stamina capacity and recovery.

items.title: Stun Pods
items.description: Exposes Hellpod wiring upon surface contact, stunning any units in the vicinity of the drop site.

items.title: Surplus EAT Allocation
items.description: Grants two free uses of the Expendable Anti-Tank (EAT) Stratagem per mission; enough to grant a full squad one single-use rocket launcher each, provided squad members employ the proper equipment distribution protocol.

items.title: UAV Recon Booster
items.description: Increases all Helldivers' effective radar range.

items.title: Vitality Enhancement
items.description: Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers.
